0.name: TEXT_JOBREL300GETGLASSAGAIN_00351_ARNOTT_000_000
0.description: You require another anima glass? Surely you jest, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. I can see it right there in your hand.
0.translation_description: Ti serve un altro Vetro dell’Anima? Stai scherzando, <hex:020817E905FF0A5369676E6F72696E61FF085369676E6F726503>! Ce l’hai proprio in mano.

1.name: TEXT_JOBREL300GETGLASSAGAIN_00351_ARNOTT_000_001
1.description: I would gladly furnish you with another, but only if you are truly in need.
1.translation_description: Te ne darei volentieri un altro, ma solo se ne hai davvero bisogno.

2.name: TEXT_JOBREL300GETGLASSAGAIN_00351_ARNOTT_000_010
2.description: You misplaced the anima glass, you say?
2.translation_description: Hai smarrito il vetro dell’Anima, dici?

3.name: TEXT_JOBREL300GETGLASSAGAIN_00351_ARNOTT_000_011
3.description: That will not do at all. Thankfully, I have prepared several more at Lady Ulan's behest for just such an occasion.
3.translation_description: Non va affatto bene. Per fortuna, su richiesta di Lady Ulan ne ho preparati altri proprio per un’occasione simile.

5.name: TEXT_JOBREL300GETGLASSAGAIN_00351_ARNOTT_000_020
5.description: Please do take care not to lose this one. I would rather not waste valuable time for research on fashioning more glass.
5.translation_description: Mi raccomando, non perdere anche questo. Preferirei non sottrarre tempo prezioso alla ricerca per fabbricarne altri.

6.name: TEXT_JOBREL300GETGLASSAGAIN_00351_ARNOTT_000_030
6.description: If you are certain you no longer require the glass, I will not question your decision.
6.translation_description: Se il Vetro dell’Anima non ti serve più, non metterò in dubbio la tua decisione.

7.name: TEXT_JOBREL300GETGLASSAGAIN_00351_ARNOTT_000_031
7.description: Should you change your mind, however, you are always welcome to take one. As Lady Ulan is wont to misplace our supplies, I make a point to always keep a surplus on hand.
7.translation_description: Se cambi idea, però, puoi sempre prenderne uno. Visto che Lady Ulan ha l’abitudine di smarrire le nostre scorte, ne tengo sempre da parte qualcuna in più.
